## Findings by module

### 1

- **extended** (ch-002.txt): Talbot: sixteen pictures a second was chosen for economy. Edison kinetoscope needed at least thirty a second for the illusion; Lumiere and Paul reduced it to sixteen; twenty-four would be practically no better. Course module 1 uses 24 fps as the standard.
